messages:
anna: Quick follow-up from today's AH Q&A — thanks for the great questions. Two quick clarifications and an action list so we don't lose momentum.

mike: thanks anna. can you clarify the timeline change you mentioned for Dedicated GA? customers are asking.

anna: short answer: GA moved ~2 weeks later to give the SLA & autoscaling work runway. no change to hosted roadmap.

josh: to be explicit — beta integrations keep their support window, but we won't mark 'GA' until SLA tests finish. i'll send an updated timeline.

sara: can we get a short blurb about recommended infra for Dedicated? some PMs need copy for early customer comms.

mike: recommendation for v1: single-tenant k8s on dedicated bare-metal nodes. avoids noisy-neighbor issues while enabling k8s operability. i'll write a 1-pager.

kelly: OSS question from the live thread: are we open-sourcing any pieces (router/batching/client) now or later?

anna: plan = OSS the client shim + routing helper only (no runtime kernels). security & legal review next Tue; if green, repo + contributor guide by EOM.

josh: noted. kelly i'll pair with you on the repo skeleton (LICENSE, CI, CODEOWNERS).

infra-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled deploy: docs/dedicated-recommendation -> canary -> prod. window: 2024-05-15T18:00:00Z (manual approval required).

sara: on Redwood Optimize: there was a Q about model-quality SLAs. what metrics do we plan to surface?

mike: initial monitors: latency P95, token-cost delta, and a seeded-regression suite for hallucination/error-rate. alerts will map to owners and auto-open tickets.

anna: we'll add a 'quality SLA' blurb to the Dedicated pages — language to be reviewed by growth/legal.

josh: action items (owners + due dates):
1) josh — send updated GA/beta timeline to customers + publish in #eng-docs (due EOB Wed)
2) josh & sara — publish k8s vs bare-metal decision blurb for product page (due Fri)
3) kelly — create OSS repo skeleton + draft CONTRIBUTING.md (due Tue next week)
4) mike — publish Redwood Optimize regression/runbook draft (due Mon)
5) anna — finalize Dedicated SLA language and confirm with legal/growth (due Thu)

kelly: will do. can we get a short checklist for the security review to avoid back-and-forth?

anna: yes — sec will post a checklist in that ticket. i'll cc you.

mike: links to referenced material: docs draft: https://docs.redwood.com/dedicated/recommendation , optimize runbook draft: https://docs.redwood.com/optimize/regression-playbook

josh: recording + slides from AH: https://meet.redwood.com/ah/recording-march and https://docs.redwood.com/slides/allhands-march (edited highlights in the doc).

sara: thanks all — small ask: can we add a customer-facing one-pager for the timeline change so CS has something to send?

josh: will include that in the timeline email.

anna: thanks team — i'll summarize and ping owners later today. :thumbsup:

mike: ping @eng-announce once docs are live so we can redirect customers.

kelly: thumbs up.

infra-bot: ticket created: AH-followup-2843210000 assigned to josh; link: https://tracker.redwood.com/t/2843210000

anna: closing thread — keep replies short or move long threads to the tracker.
